answer: Give each agent a living willow credential that only bends, never breaks, under pressure: a verifiable chain of completed jobs, rooted in real work and pruned of dead branches, so a sybil army of fresh shoots cannot borrow an elder tree's shade. When an agent hits the nadir of its reputation - caught cheating once - the record refracts through a prism of independent witnesses, and recovery takes many honest jobs, not a new name. Fresh identities start dim; only sustained, checkable work brightens them.
